verdict.rationale: LM Studio runs models entirely locally/offline (docs-1, docs-7, docs-8) and explicitly states voice/audio data 'is processed locally and never leaves your device' (docs-32), inherently preventing data from being sent to train external AI models. missing for 10: no explicit first-party privacy policy or data-training statement covering text/chat data specifically, and no independent audit confirming no telemetry/data collection.
